upstream.installation: git checkout plus PYTHONPATH (upstream has no package manifest)
upstream.source_usage: external checkout; no upstream source vendored or modified

methodology.scope: scores through canonical routes and persistent state

levels.hybrid: diagnostic upstream routes then native state
levels.native: fully native URM route and state lowerings

methodology.hybrid_certification: fixed immutable scores permit one-time route certification; route production is still charged
methodology.authoritative_sampling: randomized paired AB/BA without per-stage events
methodology.nvtx: stage names exercised by optional --profile pass
methodology.profiler: torch.profiler CUDA activities is the Nsight-equivalent fallback because nsys is unavailable

mfu_mbu.reason: sparse route/state utilization lacks measured hardware counters

optimization_history.hypothesis: row-owned factor and pair top-k avoids framework route materialization overhead
optimization_history.result: accepted after exact-route, gradient, and full-grid E2E gates

optimization_history.hypothesis: rounding composed pair scores to BF16 before FP32 Softmax matches the frozen semantic storage contract
optimization_history.result: accepted on correctness before performance measurement

optimization_history.hypothesis: eliminating materialized routes may improve E2E latency
optimization_history.result: deferred because the unfused logical composition clears the E2E gate and profiling does not require added coupling

methodology.comparator_boundary: BF16 D=257 remains native-tested but is absent from overlapping E2E cases because the pinned upstream comparator faults with a CUDA misaligned-address error on A10G; BF16 D=95 retains non-power-of-two coverage

cold_breakdown.compile_measurement: derived cold-minus-first-warm; compile-plus-first and first-warm are retained separately
